decisions.reason: Engine unit at cp 208 is the body of the {{efn|...}} note at cp 202: an explanatory gloss (Latin and Greek titles) with no cited source. Guide: unstructured is for a definition that cites something in plain text with no citation template; a gloss does not cite. Locked unstructured false stands.

Engine unit at cp 3402 is the {{harvnb|Németh|2018|p=3}} call inside the <ref> at cp 3397 followed by prose ('treats these as two separate volumes'). The call is a template, not plain-text citation, so unstructured is false under either reading of the template's status. Ambiguity: harvnb (Harvard-style citation) may count as a citation template and so belong in the definition's templates list; that field is not disputed here and is not changed. Locked label stands.
